subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a type of elasticity of demand ?
solution:
The correct answer is **Product quality elasticity of demand.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Product quality elasticity of demand:**

 
 
• This term is not a recognized type of elasticity of demand in economic theory.
 
• Elasticity of demand typically refers to how the quantity demanded of a good responds to changes in price, income, or the price of related goods, not to changes in product quality.
 
• While product quality can influence demand, it is not measured using elasticity of demand.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cross elasticity of demand:**

 
 
• This measures the responsiveness of the quantity demanded for one good to a change in the price of another good. It is particularly useful for understanding the relationship between substitute or complementary goods.
 
 
 
• **Price elasticity of demand:**
 
 
• This measures the responsiveness of the quantity demanded to a change in the price of the good itself. It helps businesses understand how changes in price can affect their sales volume and revenue.
 
 
 
• **Income elasticity of demand:**
 
 
• This measures the responsiveness of the quantity demanded to a change in consumer income. It helps to categorize goods as normal or inferior and understand how demand shifts with economic cycles.
